comment: 14yo female with biallelic FANCA germline pathogenic variants confirmed, progressive pancytopenia from age 9 + short stature + café-au-lait macules + bilateral thumb hypoplasia, positive diepoxybutane chromosome fragility. No current AML/MDS or HNSCC. Engine routes to PreventionPlan: standard = pediatric hematology q3mo CBC + annual bone marrow biopsy + HNSCC oral surveillance from age 10 + gynecologic surveillance from menarche + reduced-intensity transplant planning + alkylator/radiation hypersensitivity advisory; alternative = symptom-triggered evaluation. Validates v0.2-B rare-hereditary pilot — fires RF-FANCONI-ANEMIA-FAMILY-HISTORY-SUSPICION.
